data.name: Label14.Text
data.value: What is "id type"? Usually the name to the left of the "=" like "file.m3u8&&key=000000" | In this case, id is "key" and password is the set of 0. Click the check box first then Paste the full stream url with key. then identify the id and key in the text boxes above. This will hide the info for secuirty.

data.name: compare_mode.Text
data.value: Enable Compare Mode - This will test all Models for the Speech to Text Engine. This will legit take a while, so grab a coffee or drink some milk as it works. I recomend to only use on short clips like 30s max, or a few minutes. Don't use for 5+ minutes, unless you are going out to eat for a while.

data.name: Label17.Text
data.value:
7GB Turbo Model - Optimized version of large-v3 for much faster transcription speed. - Minimal loss in accuracy. - ⚠ Does NOT support translation; only transcription in the original language. - Recommended for fast native language transcription of audio/streams.
11GB v2 Model - More stable and significantly faster. 11GB v3 Model - More accurate, slightly slower, and a bit heavier than v2.
Half Mode Reduces processing time for all models. Note: This will also reduce accuracy. Use if speed is more important than precision.
